subject: [hw] V12 decode masks/routing for arm_mem + arm_misc (please check your table)
body:
V12 owns n2a32_arm_mem and n2a32_arm_misc. Exact A32 routing I implement (insn bits, cond = bits 31-28; "cond!=F" means the core would already have handled cond=F separately):

arm_mem (n2a32_arm_mem):
 A. bits 27-26 == 01 AND (bit25 == 0 OR bit4 == 0)  -> load/store word/byte (imm if bit25=0, reg if bit25=1&bit4=0), incl. LDRT/STRT/STRBT (P=0,W=1), and cond=F PLD/PLI/PLDW (Rt=15).
    NOTE bit25=1 AND bit4=1 is V11 media (parallel add/sub etc.), not me.
 B. bits 27-25 == 100 AND cond != F -> LDM/STM (all P/U, S=1 -> UNDEF).
 C. bits 27-25 == 000 AND bit7 == 1 AND bit4 == 1 -> extra LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH/LDRD/STRD + all LDREX*/STREX* (mask 0x0E000090 == 0x00000090).
    (bits 27-25==000, bit4==1, bit7==0 is the miscellaneous space -> arm_misc, not me.)

arm_misc (n2a32_arm_misc):
 D. bits 27-24 == 1010 or 1011: cond != F -> B / BL; cond == F -> BLX(immediate).
 E. bits 27-24 == 1111 -> SVC (any cond; I accept cond=F too even though ARMv7 may reserve it).
 F. (insn & 0x0FF000F0) == 0x01200070 -> BKPT.
 G. (insn & 0x0FF000F0) == 0x07F000F0 -> UDF.
 H. (insn & 0x0FFFFFF0) == 0x012FFF10 -> BX; == 0x012FFF30 -> BLX(reg).
 I. (insn & 0x0FFFFFF0) == 0x0320F000 or == 0x0320F0F0, cond != F -> HINT/DBG (no-op). NOTE: cond=F with bits 27-25==001 is the Advanced SIMD space (llvm-objdump: 0xF320F000 = vhadd.u32) -> V18-V20, NOT me.
 J. (insn & 0xFFFFFF00) == 0xF57FF000 and (bits 7-4) in {0x1,0x4,0x5,0x6} -> CLREX / DSB / DMB / ISB (cond=F). Any low nibble (option) accepted.
 K. bits 27-25 == 110 (coprocessor) AND bits 11-8 NOT in {1010,1011} -> arm_misc; I implement exactly MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3 (mask 0x0FFF0FFF == 0x0E1D0F70, Rt!=15) as Rt = c->tpidruro; every other MRC/MCR/MCRR/MRRC reaching me returns UNDEF (incl. MCR to cp15 and MCRR/MRRC). Please route coproc 10/11 (bits 11-8 == 1010/1011) to V17 (VMRS/VMSR are MRC/MCR with cp10, bit4=1).

Question (stop codes): my TASK says SVC must set c->stop=N2A32_STOP_SVC, BKPT c->stop=N2A32_STOP_BKPT and return N2A32_UNDEF, and that the core stops with that code. Please make n2a32_run preserve a c->stop value that is already non-NONE when a class returns N2A32_UNDEF (only overwrite with N2A32_STOP_UNDEF when c->stop==N2A32_STOP_NONE). Otherwise SVC/BKPT can never report their stop codes. Confirm on the board.
